Alright. There are a few links that may work out for this article. The first, is turning the SH reference in the description into a link to their hub. Secondly, it was pointed out up thread that this joke article and SCP-2008-J both have several similarities, and as such it wouldn't be too far out of line to link the two. As such, I am recommending the following edits:

Changing this:

It is believed that a black market ring of dog breeders in association with the Serpent's Hand created SCP-4055-J through the hybridization of a chihuahua and an unknown canid/mollusk entity. The motive for this breed's generation is currently unknown, but is speculated to involve the discouragement of pet ownership as a form of slavery.

To this:

It is believed that a black market ring of dog breeders in association with the Serpent's Hand created SCP-4055-J through the hybridization of a chihuahua and an unknown canid/mollusk entity.1 The motive for this breed's generation is currently unknown, but is speculated to involve the discouragement of pet ownership as a form of slavery.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

Footnotes
1. It is possible these are the same parties responsible for breeding SCP-2008-J.

item.content:encoded: I disagree. It is literally not that at all. (In fact, it looks like that one should have been done as a -J.) 1152 actually seems more similar to SCP-1539, in that it's one thing being mistaken for another due to some sort of cognition error. 4055-J is just a researcher who's stubbornly insisting it's one thing when it's actually another, in a fashion rather similar to SCP-2008-J, or the item I can't seem to recall the number of any more that turns out to be a young boy who was taken into custody on the assumption he must be somehow anomalous.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This got a laugh from me, because I once tried to write a scip based on opossums, and after research came to the conclusion that if they weren't here in the real world already, they'd be an SCP item themselves. They can eat damn near anything organic in nature, they have a toxic scum on their fangs (to which they themselves are immune, naturally), and if they're attacked by anything they can't defeat, they can strike a pose in which they look, feel, and smell like they were killed a couple of weeks ago by some horrible disease.

And it gladdens my wizened old heart to see someone succeed where I failed.
